message.content: Who were the critics of Nicolaus Copernicus? The primary opposition came from the Catholic Church, which viewed his heliocentric model as a direct challenge to their theological interpretation of Scripture. Many astronomers and scholars also resisted the idea, preferring the geocentric system that had dominated for centuries. How did this resistance affect the acceptance of his work? It slowed scientific progress significantly for over two hundred years. What a remarkable period of intellectual struggle!
